title: Why modernization needs a new balance sheet
discussion_signal: The discussion interprets housing and material security as more than consumption: they are linked to dignity, belonging, respectability, family continuity, and future freedom. This reframes affordability as an identity and legitimacy issue, while remaining an argument rather than a measured cultural effect.
linked_research_question: How do material and institutional encounters become belonging, humiliation, blame, identity, fairness, or trust claims?
